review.tagline: React admin dashboard template built on Ant Design 6 and Umi Max
review.summary: Ant Design Pro is a React 19 and TypeScript boilerplate for enterprise back-office apps, built on Umi Max 4 and antd 6. It ships ready-made pages for dashboards, forms, lists, profiles, account settings, login and error screens, plus i18n, mock data and unit and e2e tests. A built-in AI chatbot page uses Ant Design X, and an `npm run simple` script strips the template down to a minimal version.
review.audience: React teams building enterprise admin UIs on Ant Design
strengths: Includes dashboard, form, list, profile, account and result page templates
Built-in i18n, mock development setup, and unit and e2e tests
Ships Claude Code skills for upgrading the template and querying antd APIs
TypeScript with Tailwind CSS v4 and antd-style theming
weaknesses: AI support is a single chatbot page; no model backend is described
`npm run simple` permanently deletes files and cannot be undone
Tied to the Umi Max and antd stack; no other frameworks
No Docker or compose setup mentioned in the README
